meta.title: T. L. Harris — District 6
meta.description: The District 6 officeholder site, running as a full WordPress install in your browser. No server, nothing to install.

steps.code:
<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';

$patterns = get_stylesheet_directory() . '/patterns/';
$pages = array(
  'T. L. Harris' => array('home','page-home'),
  'About' => array('about','page-about'),
  'District 6' => array('district-6','page-district-6'),
  'Board Work' => array('board-work','page-board-work'),
  'Priorities & Progress' => array('priorities-progress','page-priorities-progress'),
  'News & Updates' => array('news','page-news'),
  'Events' => array('events','page-events'),
  'Get Help' => array('get-help','page-get-help'),
  'Press & Media' => array('press','page-press'),
  'Contact' => array('contact','page-contact'),
  'Get Involved' => array('get-involved','page-get-involved'),
  'Support' => array('support','page-support'),
  'Privacy' => array('privacy',''),
  'Terms' => array('terms',''),
  'Accessibility' => array('accessibility',''),
);
foreach ($pages as $title => $cfg) {
  list($slug, $pat) = $cfg;
  $content = '';
  if ($pat && file_exists($patterns . $pat . '.php')) {
    $content = preg_replace('/^<\?php[\s\S]*?\?>\s*/', '', file_get_contents($patterns . $pat . '.php'));
  }
  $existing = get_page_by_path($slug);
  $data = array('post_type'=>'page','post_title'=>$title,'post_name'=>$slug,'post_status'=>'publish','post_content'=>$content);
  if ($existing) { $data['ID'] = $existing->ID; wp_update_post($data); } else { wp_insert_post($data); }
}
$home = get_page_by_path('home');
update_option('show_on_front','page');
update_option('page_on_front',$home->ID);

if (function_exists('tlharris_import_schools')) {
  tlharris_import_schools(); tlharris_import_meetings(); tlharris_import_priorities();
  foreach (array('district_school','event','priority') as $pt) {
    foreach (get_posts(array('post_type'=>$pt,'post_status'=>'draft','posts_per_page'=>-1,'fields'=>'ids')) as $id) {
      wp_update_post(array('ID'=>$id,'post_status'=>'publish'));
    }
  }
}
flush_rewrite_rules(true);
